payload.title: Automatically synchronize unified angles with visible progress and retry
payload.description: Determine present behavior of Unify selected angles; start audio synchronization automatically, show Syncing audio and a loading indicator, expose retry on unsynced/failed/interrupted assets. Keep project/editor authority canonical and guard background work across project changes.
acceptance: Unifying supported selected camera assets starts existing audio synchronization automatically without blocking asset creation.
UI distinguishes syncing, synced and failed/interrupted states; syncing shows loading/progress and unsynced state can retry with one click.
Canonical runtime owns serializable synchronization state and validated transitions; UI/IO orchestration cannot mutate independent project state.
Meaningful regressions cover auto-start, duplicate prevention, failure/retry, cancellation/stale scope and preservation; deploy and verify the resulting product flow.
